title: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella remains confident in Nvidia after Huang’s exit
lede: Satya Nadella told the DealBook Summit he still has confidence in Nvidia after Jensen Huang's exit, pointing to interim CEO Colette Kress, who spent years at Microsoft.

points: Nadella called the situation tragic and said he wants to give Huang, whom he has long admired, space.
Huang stepped down last week after 33 years as CEO, following reports of an affair with a Megaspeed executive US officials believe is a Chinese spy, and affairs with two Nvidia employees.
Nadella said he is in touch with the same Nvidia people as before, and Nvidia remains a close Microsoft partner.
Drawing on Bill Gates, he said founders are singular but not gods, and a company that wants to last needs someone to take over.
